title: Consultor Senior Valuation
description:
Junte-se a Forvis Mazars

Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.

Sobre Nós

Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.

Como uma empresa global mantemos alto nível de excelência garantindo uma experiência única através de qualificação, trabalho integrado, tecnologia e desenvolvimento contínuo de nosso time.

Sua Jornada Conosco

Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.

Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir frentes de trabalho em projetos de valuation, estruturando modelos, definindo premissas e aplicando metodologias adequadas, sempre em alinhamento com a liderança.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes para validar premissas e esclarecer aspectos financeiros, estratégicos e regulatórios.
  • Realizar análises críticas sobre riscos de avaliação, assegurando consistência com CPCs e IFRS.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de laudos técnicos e apresentações executivas para suporte a decisões estratégicas.
  • Revisar modelos desenvolvidos por consultores juniores e plenos, fornecendo orientação técnica e feedback construtivo.
  • Colaborar com times de auditoria, consultoria e M&A durante todo o processo de avaliação.


Requisitos


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em valuation, modelagem econômico-financeira e projetos de M&A.
  • Conhecimento avançado em CPC 01 e CPC 15.
  • Excel avançado


Benefícios

  • Serviço de telemedicina;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação (Cartão Flash) – flexibilidade para o seu dia a dia;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica (Amil);
  • Assistência Odontológica (Amil);
  • Seguro de vida (SulAmérica)
  • Descontos e, incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.

Se você se identificou com o nosso jeito de ser, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Aqui teremos diversas oportunidades e desafios para que você possa contribuir e se desenvolver em conjunto conosco.

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
If you're a commissions-driven Tech Recruiter with a killer work ethic, there couldn't be a more perfect job for you!


Who you'll work for

Revilo is a recruitment agency that specializes in the AI- SaaS hiring space. They partner directly with early-stage, high-growth tech companies that are building cutting-edge teams from scratch.


What you’ll do

  • Source, screen and engage top-tier candidates for Technical roles (mostly Full Stack Python Developers )
  • Manage full-cycle recruiting from intake through offer, with high volumes of roles and opportunities .
  • Use best-in-class tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, JuiceBox etc.) to drive sourcing, outreach and candidate engagement.
  • Work to aggressive hiring targets; the harder you work, the more you earn (UNCAPPED commissions! )
  • Maintain recruiting metrics, track performance and continuously improve sourcing and conversion rates.


What we’re looking for

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven experience in high-volume Technical recruiting
  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, sourcing platforms and modern recruiting tech stack.
  • Ability to manage multiple roles, pipelines and priorities simultaneously.
  • You thrive on reward: this is a commission-rich role with high earning potential.


What you’ll get

  • Base salary from USD 2,500-3,000/month plus uncapped commissions (top performers earn ~$2,000-$3,000/month just in commissions! ).
  • FULLY remote role — work from where you are!
  • Access to top recruiting tools, full tech stack to let you focus on making big wins!
  • PTO, benefits and opportunity to grow quickly into a high-impact role with visibility.
  • Startup-energy culture: fast-moving, ambitious, rewarding.

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:



Descrição do Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados Senior


Personalidade: Pessoa hands on (code), com conhecimento de DataOps e onpremise

Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados para a ingestão, limpeza e transformação de dados.

• Coletar, limpar e transformar dados brutos em formatos utilizáveis para análise.

• Modelar e utilizar bancos de dados relacionais (SQL), e data warehouses.

• Colaborar com analistas de dados para fornecer datasets refinados


Conhecimento Técnico

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de fluxos de dados (Ex: Nifi, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue ETL)

• Conhecimento em Python e SQL

• Conhecimento em modelagem de dados

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de transformação de dados (Ex: dbt, EMR, Databricks)

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex: Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Degster)

• Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL).

• Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se efetivamente em inglês.

• Capacidade de aprender e seguir padrões de trabalho (Agile)

• Capacidade de identificar problemas e sugerir soluções.


Inglês: Avançado ou Fluente


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As the JAVA Engineering Team Lead , you will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of talented developers, overseeing the development and maintenance of our Java-based gaming platform. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, designers, architects, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions. Your role will involve a combination of hands-on development, technical leadership, and strategic planning.


The impact you will have:


  • You will be responsible for leading, motivating, and developing a team of engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.
  • You will oversee the complete development cycle of the Java gaming platform, ensuring quality, security, and best practices.
  • You will collaborate with managers and principal engineers in defining requirements, deadlines, and strategic technical decisions.
  • You will be required to monitor project progress, remove blockers, and ensure timely deliveries aligned with business objectives.
  • You will also participate in code review, complex troubleshooting, and the promotion of continuous improvement for the team and its processes.


What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, Agile methodologies, and DevOps tools.
  • Advanced English.
  • Good communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills are essential.
  • Knowledge of Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Micronaut) and SQL databases is also valued.
  • This role is Remote based in Brazil.





Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior & Líder Técnico
description:
Descrição da Vaga: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior & Líder Técnico

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior com fortes habilidades de liderança técnica para integrar uma equipe internacional de desenvolvimento. Este profissional será responsável por liderar a concepção e implementação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e eficientes, atuando em ambas as camadas (front-end e back-end), além de mentorar outros desenvolvedores e apoiar práticas ágeis de desenvolvimento.

Esta é uma oportunidade desafiadora para quem busca atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com tecnologia de ponta e alto impacto técnico e estratégico.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar novas funcionalidades em sistemas front-end e back-end utilizando tecnologias modernas de desenvolvimento web.
  • Analisar sistemas existentes, definir requisitos de integração e propor melhorias técnicas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais (desenvolvimento, arquitetura, DevOps, produto) para garantir a entrega eficaz de soluções.
  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurar a qualidade do software e orientar membros juniores da equipe.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis (como sprint planning, daily meetings, retrospectives) e alinhar entregas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Investigar e resolver problemas complexos que afetam sistemas em larga escala, propondo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis.



Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência relevante com desenvolvimento de software.
  • Stack obrigatória: C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core Web API + Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS .
  • Experiência avançada com Entity Framework , Microsoft SQL Server e ajuste de desempenho de consultas e bancos de dados.
  • Conhecimento profundo em microsserviços , arquitetura orientada a eventos e padrões de projeto (ex: Saga).
  • Experiência com Docker ou Kubernetes , pipelines de CI/CD e ferramentas como Azure DevOps ou equivalentes.
  • Habilidade comprovada em liderar equipes de desenvolvimento, facilitar práticas ágeis e interagir com arquitetos de solução.
  • Inglês avançado para reports a times estrangeiros.
  • Capacidade de atuar como líder técnico e Scrum Master simultaneamente.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido em São Paulo, SP.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e padrões de mensageria assíncrona (ex: RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento em IIS , serviços Microsoft Azure e arquitetura de sistemas corporativos.
  • Atuação prévia em domínios de negócio complexos, como commodity trading , finanças ou logística, será considerado um diferencial.


O que Oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente internacional com alto padrão técnico.
  • Trabalho remoto com flexibilidade de horários.
  • Integração com equipes globais e projetos de grande escala.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com foco em inovação, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia de software.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work

  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.

If you're a commissions-driven Tech Recruiter with a killer work ethic, there couldn't be a more perfect job for you!


Who you'll work for

Revilo is a recruitment agency that specializes in the AI- SaaS hiring space. They partner directly with early-stage, high-growth tech companies that are building cutting-edge teams from scratch.


What you’ll do

  • Source, screen and engage top-tier candidates for Technical roles (mostly Full Stack Python Developers )
  • Manage full-cycle recruiting from intake through offer, with high volumes of roles and opportunities .
  • Use best-in-class tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, JuiceBox etc.) to drive sourcing, outreach and candidate engagement.
  • Work to aggressive hiring targets; the harder you work, the more you earn (UNCAPPED commissions! )
  • Maintain recruiting metrics, track performance and continuously improve sourcing and conversion rates.


What we’re looking for

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven experience in high-volume Technical recruiting

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Especialista de Implantação HCM
description:
RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO


Como Especialista de Implantação HCM, você atuará como facilitador entre a equipe de implementação e os clientes para entender melhor suas necessidades de negócios.

Atuará também como mentor ou treinador de parceiros. Preparará especificações funcionais, incluindo detalhes sobre design e configuração.



FUNÇÕES:


  • Resolver os problemas reportados nos SLAs.
  • Configuração do SAP HCM PY para folha de pagamento dos EUA, Canadá ou México
  • Fornecer aos clientes o status das implementações
  • Guarde a documentação do cliente
  • Fornecer suporte a aplicativos
  • Reunir-se com clientes sempre que necessário
  • Aplicar conhecimento funcional relevante específico do país para potencializar o serviço focado no cliente
  • Realizar testes unitários
  • Fornecer documentação



REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência em implementação SAP HCM, módulo de folha de pagamento (PY)
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês em nível avançado para conversação



Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

Como Especialista de Implantação HCM, você atuará como facilitador entre a equipe de implementação e os clientes para entender melhor suas necessidades de negócios.

Atuará também como mentor ou treinador de parceiros. Preparará especificações funcionais, incluindo detalhes sobre design e configuração.



FUNÇÕES:


  • Resolver os problemas reportados nos SLAs.
  • Configuração do SAP HCM PY para folha de pagamento dos EUA, Canadá ou México
  • Fornecer aos clientes o status das implementações
  • Guarde a documentação do cliente
  • Fornecer suporte a aplicativos
  • Reunir-se com clientes sempre que necessário
  • Aplicar conhecimento funcional relevante específico do país para potencializar o serviço focado no cliente
  • Realizar testes unitários
  • Fornecer documentação



REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência em implementação SAP HCM, módulo de folha de pagamento (PY)
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês em nível avançado para conversação



Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

We are looking for a smart, proactive Mobile Developer with strong communication skills to join our team. The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience in mobile development, is able to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, and is comfortable delivering high-quality features in fast-paced Agile environments. Experience with Java or Kotlin is mandatory , and iOs experience is a strong plus .


Responsibilities

  • Design and build advanced applications for mobile platforms (Android primarily, iOS is a bonus).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Ensure performance, quality, and responsiveness of mobile applications.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs.
  • Maintain clean, testable, well-organized code and contribute to automation processes.
  • Work with APIs, third-party libraries, and modern mobile architectures.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in mobile development.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum processes, contributing to planning, reviews, and team discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Medium-level experience in mobile development (approximately 3–5 years).
  • Proficient in Java or Kotlin (at least one is required).
  • Experience implementing and customizing video player functionality using frameworks such as ExoPlayer or MediaSession APIs, including handling streaming, offline playback, and custom UI controls.
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile development lifecycle.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs to connect Android applications to backend services.
  • Familiarity with push notifications and cloud messaging APIs (e.g., Firebase).
  • Knowledge of Google’s material design principles and interface guidelines.
  • Strong understanding of architecture patterns (MVVM, Clean Architecture).
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD practices, and testing frameworks.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Jetpack components (e.g., Room, Hilt, WorkManager, LiveData, ViewModel).
  • Experience with Dependency Injection frameworks (Hilt, Dagger, or Koin).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
  • Experience with media playback, DRM, caching, performance profiling, or offline-first applications.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for Android.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Enginee r who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

- English

Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;

- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key responsibilities:

Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;

- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data;

- Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines

Data lake, aws, spark, python

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Enginee r who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

- English

Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;

- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key responsibilities:

Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;

- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data;

- Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines

Data lake, aws, spark, python

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Consultor Senior Valuation
description:
Junte-se a Forvis Mazars

Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.

Sobre Nós

Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.

Como uma empresa global mantemos alto nível de excelência garantindo uma experiência única através de qualificação, trabalho integrado, tecnologia e desenvolvimento contínuo de nosso time.

Sua Jornada Conosco

Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.

Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir frentes de trabalho em projetos de valuation, estruturando modelos, definindo premissas e aplicando metodologias adequadas, sempre em alinhamento com a liderança.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes para validar premissas e esclarecer aspectos financeiros, estratégicos e regulatórios.
  • Realizar análises críticas sobre riscos de avaliação, assegurando consistência com CPCs e IFRS.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de laudos técnicos e apresentações executivas para suporte a decisões estratégicas.
  • Revisar modelos desenvolvidos por consultores juniores e plenos, fornecendo orientação técnica e feedback construtivo.
  • Colaborar com times de auditoria, consultoria e M&A durante todo o processo de avaliação.


Requisitos


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em valuation, modelagem econômico-financeira e projetos de M&A.
  • Conhecimento avançado em CPC 01 e CPC 15.
  • Excel avançado


Benefícios

  • Serviço de telemedicina;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação (Cartão Flash) – flexibilidade para o seu dia a dia;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica (Amil);
  • Assistência Odontológica (Amil);
  • Seguro de vida (SulAmérica)
  • Descontos e, incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.

Se você se identificou com o nosso jeito de ser, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Aqui teremos diversas oportunidades e desafios para que você possa contribuir e se desenvolver em conjunto conosco.
